what: When the photo collection plate touches the center of the screen (center center) it pins, and while scrolling down 2000px the central 16:9 photo cell widens linearly from its initial width (36%) to the plate width (100%). The surrounding photos are attached at positions relative to the center cell, so they get pushed outward as it grows. At 1024px and below it runs for 1000px starting when the plate’s top edge touches 35% of the screen, and at 834px and below it doesn’t move.

options.end: Fixed distance (px), default 2000 — adding a screen-side reference like ”2000 bottom” ends it when that distance touches the bottom of the screen (fixed distance = 2000 − screen height)
options.end-md: Fixed distance at 1024px and below (px), default 1000
options.start: Fixed start, default center center (top 35% at 1024px and below)
options.min: Not applied at or below this width (px), default 834
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Inner panel placed at center (required) — holds the cells and surrounding photos
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Surrounding photos — give left, top and width in % relative to the cell and they shift along with the cell (optional)

from.where: index.html .field (pin where the photo collection grows) — original top.js initGalleryAnimation: js-top-field__img-wrap width → 100%, start center center(1024↓ top 35%), end +=2000(1024↓ +=1000), scrub true, pin, none below 834

index.html .og-gallery (first-page photo collage — original jn: #js-index_gallery start top top · end "+=2000 bottom" · scrub · pin, center cell 48% → 100%, the five surrounding photos sit at cell-relative % positions with translate(-50%,-50%))
from.options: start: top top; end: 2000 bottom; min: 1024 · --fx-w: 48%

note: Surrounding photos sit inside the cell and are placed by % of the cell, so they spread along with the cell width — in the original, the surrounding photos are also attached to the cell and get pushed along
